title: Enable HiDPI scaling in KDE Plasma
summary: Adjust the global scale factor in KDE Plasma to improve readability on HiDPI displays. This affects fonts, icons, and widgets.

steps.explain: Open System Settings and go to Display Configuration.
steps.gui: System Settings > Display and Monitor > Display Configuration

steps.explain: Find the 'Global Scale' slider and drag it to the desired size.
Log out and log back in, or reboot the computer.
